source_semantics: ApplicationUsers renders Clear only while the bound _search value is nonblank. ClearSearchClickedAsync clears _search first and then awaits LoadAsync, which reloads the authoritative application-user list and assignable-role state while _working prevents concurrent actions and surfaces failures instead of reporting false success.
laravel_adaptation: The React Application Users workspace exposes the canonical Clear control only for an authorized nonblank search. The caller clears the controlled search state, resets pagination, and then awaits a GET reread of the application-users endpoint derived from the active tenant context. The endpoint is /tenants/{tenant}/admin/members behind authenticated session and tenant.context middleware; the control additionally requires members.manage to preserve the source page's management-policy boundary. The control owns no tenant identifier, resource identifier, WordPress credential, connector secret, AI provider state, queue, cache, or scheduler state.
security_invariants: The reread URL is derived from context.api['application-users'] for the active tenant rather than from user-supplied tenant or membership identifiers.
auth plus tenant.context middleware owns cross-tenant resolution; a foreign tenant fails closed as not found before authoritative member data can be accepted.

The visible control is withheld unless members.manage (or the explicit wildcard permission) is present, preserving the source UsersManage policy boundary even though the underlying read endpoint also requires tenant.view.
This operation is read-only: it performs no member mutation, WordPress write, connector action, AI/provider action, secret access, queue dispatch, cache mutation, or scheduler mutation.
Duplicate clicks are locked while the authoritative reread is running, and a failed reread is surfaced without fabricating successful refreshed data.
failure_behavior: The local search value is cleared before the authoritative reread, matching the source order. If the tenant-scoped reread fails, React Query retains the real error state and the control reports failure rather than claiming success; the operation remains safely retryable after the in-flight lock is released.
